hypothesis: One controlled context-capacity test: 1024-label contexts were weaker than v6; test the largest label context allowed by the same 1GiB hardware-only guard. No architecture, router, ensemble or blend-weight search.
router: MiniBatchKMeans, n_init=1, batch_size=8192, max_iter=100, max_no_improvement=20, random_state=20261018
router_inputs: 17 train-only median/quantile-normal numeric features, four train-only one-hot categorical features, train-only standardized source-teacher logit; no id, target or heldout fit
model_inputs: raw 21 predictors plus independently trained original-source teacher logit
context_rows: Chosen without scores: first successful context among8192,4096,2048 under process VRAM<=1GiB and projected primary<=20min
context_selection: Same128 train-only routes. Up to context_rows/2 local training samples, remainder outside route, deterministic uniform label-blind selection.
immutable_weights_reuse: Probe A-B-A and native reload comparisons both exactly zero; fit resets native encoders, ensemble and KV context each route
selection: Existing W3 primary/confirmation/OOF gates unchanged. No weight search, heldout early stopping or validation-based route/context selection.
cutoffs: Existing W3 start 10:10 UTC, hard stop 10:45 UTC, absolute end 11:06 UTC
